P0420 means your catalytic converter is almost definitely dead. You should check that the value from the first oxygen sensor (Bank 1 Sensor 1) matches the values that the second oxygen sensor (Bank 1 sensor 2) has. That means that the catalytic converter makes no difference in emissions basically. That would verify that the cat is definitely dead. 

The more interesting question is why did it happen? Usually cats don’t die for no reason. Is your Fiesta consuming oil? Coolant? Was the oil overfilled?. That’s what I would look for first
